description: Scenario: CI environment has no DNS resolver or trust anchors loaded. store/server_stores.rs::new_mem_impl calls mail_auth::MessageAuthenticator::new().expect('dkim authenticator'). mail-auth's authenticator construction can fail if the system TLS trust store is inaccessible. The .expect() panics the process rather than returning an Err. Any test that constructs ServerStores via new_mem_impl in an environment without DNS or a system trust store will panic instead of receiving a usable error.
title: new_mem_impl panics on DKIM authenticator init failure — breaks offline CI
